{{Top|leg}}
'''Statute 312b''',<ref name="HoloNet News">{{InsiderCite|71|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:10:03}}</ref> also known as the '''Fourth Constitutional Amendment''', was a modification to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] passed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The amendment further granted the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], and [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] more voting power than [[Planet/Legends|planets]] farther out in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], accelerating the secession of outlying worlds into the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
